blocks.title: Geometry of black holes
blocks.body: A project in mathematical general relativity under Professor Mihalis Dafermos. The work develops geometric and analytic tools for understanding black-hole spacetimes and the global behaviour of solutions to the Einstein equations.

blocks.body: An investigation in low-dimensional topology, centred on surfaces and geometric decompositions, including Allen Hatcher’s treatment of the Kirby torus trick.
